visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up high-resolution shot of a large Paris-Brest puff pastry ring. The pastry is deeply golden-brown, adorned with sliced almonds and dusted with powdered sugar, revealing a thick, piped layer of light brown hazelnut mousseline cream in the center. (2) The scene transitions to a medium shot featuring two men standing behind a wooden counter in a kitchen studio. On the left, Chef A-Chen wears a professional white chef jacket; on the right, the host wears a casual multi-colored button-up shirt over a grey tee. They are gesturing enthusiastically towards the camera. (3) Macro shot of a glass jar labeled in French, containing a rich, dark brown hazelnut praline paste. A golden spoon dips into the jar, lifting a generous amount of the smooth, glossy paste to demonstrate its thick, viscous consistency. (4) The camera focuses on the chef's hands as he combines pale yellow custard cream with softened butter blocks into a stainless steel stand mixer. The cream is scraped from a plastic bowl with a white spatula into the metal mixing bowl. (5) A montage of the assembly process follows: the chef uses a serrated knife to carefully slice the large puff ring horizontally. He then uses a piping bag with a star tip to swirl dense Mousseline cream onto the bottom half in circular patterns, creating height and texture. (6) Final presentation shots show the completed Paris-Brest being dusted with a fine layer of powdered sugar through a small metal sieve. The host is seen tasting the cream with a spoon, closing his eyes and smiling with exaggerated delight. (7) The two men sit at a table for a Q&A session, with pieces of the dessert on white plates before them. They converse with active hand gestures, occasionally laughing and looking towards each other in a conversational manner.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal, energetic introduction featuring two male voices speaking in Traditional Chinese. An upbeat acoustic guitar and light drum beat provide a cheerful BGM foundation. The speech rate is fast and the tone is humorous. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect punctuates the transition to the kitchen segment. The BGM continues as the chef explains the pastry ingredients. The rhythmic clinking of a spoon against glass and the viscous squelching sound of the praline paste are audible. (3) A distinct mechanical whirring sound of a stand mixer enters the mix, accompanied by the muffled sound of cream being scraped. The vocals remain clear and dominant over the mechanical noise. A sudden 'ding' bell SFX highlights a key ingredient addition. (4) The acoustic texture changes as the chef slices the pastry; a crisp, dry 'crunch' sound is heard, suggesting a firm, baked crust. This is followed by a series of 'pop' cartoon sound effects synchronized with the piping of the cream. (5) Loud, collective laughter and an exaggerated 'Wow' vocalization from both men dominate the mix during the assembly. The BGM swells slightly during a montage of the final dusting process. (6) The final phase features a lower arousal but sustained conversational flow as the men sit for Q&A. The BGM shifts to a more rhythmic, steady pulse. Occasional 'whoosh' sounds mark the appearance of on-screen text questions.
